body.statement: For one ordered pair, the deterministic margin event \(\lvert\widehat\gamma_{pq}-\gamma_{pq}\rvert\le w_n\) reduces exactly as follows: if \(\gamma_{pq}\le0\), then \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}\le w_n\) and \(\Psi_n=0\); if \(\gamma_{pq}\ge3w_n\), then \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}\ge2w_n>w_n\) and \(\Psi_n=1\). Thus the strict rejection rule has no unresolved equality case at the advertised power boundary.
body.justification: This explicit reduction repairs the weak-boundary arithmetic and records the exact deterministic implication used for size and power.
body.gap: The calculation is a required soundness reduction for the new band construction rather than a separate literature claim.
body.consumer: Reviewers and implementers can audit the strict testing threshold without relying on an implicit equality convention.
